PC: You identified that I recently quit tobacco, but I am having trouble staying quit
Smoking does not get rid of stress: it causes it. (The “hit”/withdrawal cycle)
Withdrawal (irritability, anxiousness, restlessness and impatience) feels like stress. Smoking gets rid of withdrawal. Smokers mix up relieving withdrawal with getting rid of stress.
There is no ingredient in a cigarette that will get rid of stress or calm the smoker.
Most ex-smokers report feeling calmer and less stressed than smokers.

There are many healthy alternatives to help one deal with stress. The student should recommend or refer you to something:
Formal Exercise
Getting Active—Walking, Tennis, Golf, etc
Stress Management/Meditation Classes
Talking to friends/relatives/clergy
Positive self-talk/visualization
Visualization techniques
SBP: Student should set up some type of follow up with you.
